verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an official `browser-use` CLI exists (installed via `uvx --from browser-use[cli] browser-use --mcp`) and successfully speaks the MCP protocol, and `uv pip install browser-use` works cleanly — solid evidence of a real, functioning CLI package. However, documentation coverage is thin: no first-party docs page walks through general CLI usage (task running, flags, output) beyond the MCP-serving mode. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI reference docs, example of running an agent task directly from the CLI (not just --mcp), independent community confirmation of CLI usage outside MCP.
